# Tree

> Accessible tree view with roving keyboard navigation, single/multi selection, and animated disclosure.

This file matches the installed `tree` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/tree.json
```

With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/tree.md`.

## npm dependencies

- `@base-ui/react@^1.9.0`
- `lucide-react@^1.47.0`

## Registry dependencies

- `core`
- `track-highlight`

## Exports

- `@/components/control-ui/knob-contracts/tree-knobs`: `treeKnobs`, types `TreeKnobStyle`
- `@/components/control-ui/ui/tree`: `Tree`, `TreeItem`, `TreeItemTrigger`, `TreeItemIndicator`, `TreeItemLabel`, `TreeItemContent`, types `TreeSelectionMode`, `TreeInteractionReason`, `TreeSelectionChangeDetails`, `TreeExpandedChangeDetails`, `TreeSelectionIndicator`, `TreeProps`, `TreeItemProps`, `TreeItemTriggerProps`, `TreeItemIndicatorProps`, `TreeItemLabelProps`, `TreeItemContentProps`

## Composition

### Branching tree

```tsx
<Tree>
  <TreeItem>
    <TreeItemTrigger>
      <TreeItemIndicator />
      <TreeItemLabel />
    </TreeItemTrigger>
    <TreeItemContent>
      <TreeItem>
        <TreeItemTrigger>
          <TreeItemLabel />
        </TreeItemTrigger>
      </TreeItem>
    </TreeItemContent>
  </TreeItem>
</Tree>
```

## Usage

```tsx
"use client";

import { Tree, TreeItem, TreeItemContent, TreeItemIndicator, TreeItemLabel, TreeItemTrigger } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/tree";

export function PrimitiveTreeExample() {
  return (
    <Tree
      aria-label="Project files"
      indicator="slide"
      defaultExpandedValue={["src", "src/lib"]}
      defaultValue={["src/app.tsx"]}
      className="w-full max-w-xs"
    >
      <TreeItem value="src">
        <TreeItemTrigger>
          <TreeItemIndicator />
          <TreeItemLabel>src</TreeItemLabel>
        </TreeItemTrigger>
        <TreeItemContent>
          <TreeItem value="src/app.tsx">
            <TreeItemTrigger>
              <TreeItemIndicator />
              <TreeItemLabel>app.tsx</TreeItemLabel>
            </TreeItemTrigger>
          </TreeItem>
          <TreeItem value="src/lib">
            <TreeItemTrigger>
              <TreeItemIndicator />
              <TreeItemLabel>lib</TreeItemLabel>
            </TreeItemTrigger>
            <TreeItemContent>
              <TreeItem value="src/lib/cn.ts">
                <TreeItemTrigger>
                  <TreeItemIndicator />
                  <TreeItemLabel>cn.ts</TreeItemLabel>
                </TreeItemTrigger>
              </TreeItem>
              <TreeItem value="src/lib/format.ts">
                <TreeItemTrigger>
                  <TreeItemIndicator />
                  <TreeItemLabel>format.ts</TreeItemLabel>
                </TreeItemTrigger>
              </TreeItem>
            </TreeItemContent>
          </TreeItem>
        </TreeItemContent>
      </TreeItem>
      <TreeItem value="README.md">
        <TreeItemTrigger>
          <TreeItemIndicator />
          <TreeItemLabel>README.md</TreeItemLabel>
        </TreeItemTrigger>
      </TreeItem>
    </Tree>
  );
}
```

## Anatomy

Scopes, their parts, and the state attributes each part carries. Selector pattern: `[data-skin="{skin}"] :where([data-slot="{part}"][data-control-family="{family}"])`.

- `tree`
  - `item`: `data-disabled`, `data-label` (any value), `data-selected`, `data-value` (any value)
  - `item-content`: `data-state` (`closed` | `open`)
  - `item-group`
  - `item-indicator`: `data-state` (`closed` | `open`)
  - `item-label`
  - `item-trigger`: `data-selected`, `data-state` (`closed` | `open`)
  - `list`
  - `root`: `data-indicator` (`none` | `slide`)

## Knobs

Registered `--cui-*` custom properties with their recipe defaults. Set them through the component's `style` prop or a skin.

### tree

- `--cui-tree-item-trigger-radius`: `var(--radius-popup-item)`
- `--cui-tree-item-trigger-foreground`: `var(--foreground)`
- `--cui-tree-item-trigger-hover-background`: `var(--hover-fill)`
- `--cui-tree-item-trigger-hover-foreground`: `var(--foreground)`
- `--cui-tree-item-trigger-selected-background`: `var(--active-fill)`
- `--cui-tree-item-trigger-selected-foreground`: `var(--foreground)`
- `--cui-tree-item-trigger-font-size`: `var(--text-body)`
- `--cui-tree-item-trigger-selected-font-weight`: `var(--font-weight-normal)`
- `--cui-tree-indent-inset`: `1.25rem`
- `--cui-tree-item-trigger-background`: `transparent`
- `--cui-tree-guide-background`: `transparent`
- `--cui-tree-guide-inline-size`: `1px`
